desc: Build the tree adjacency list from input.
Fix DFS recurrence: at each node v, sum residuals from children, add 1 for v itself, if total >= K subtract K, return total % K.
Verify on sample 1 (should output Yes) and sample 2 (should output No).
Test additional cases: K=1 (always Yes), path graph of NK vertices (always Yes), star graph (depends on K and N).
Output "Yes" if root residual is 0, else "No".
